title: 克格莫·泡泡小碗
description: 圆润的克格莫趴在矮桌边看一碗倒映天空的清水，保留甲壳、触须和小短腿。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Kog'Maw is a squat four-legged Void creature with a rounded armored back, small bright eyes above a broad muzzle, little antenna-like projections, and a short tapering tail. Preserve his distinctive low heavy silhouette and patterned chitin rather than making him an ordinary dog. Keep the mouth gently closed or softly smiling, with no dripping acid, exposed teeth, bodily fluids, or frightening texture.
art_direction.scene: He rests beside a low stool and peers into a shallow bowl of clear water reflecting a simple cloud shape. A tiny leaf floats in the bowl, catching his curiosity without being eaten. Two smooth pebbles and a pale garden wall complete the setting, with all four little legs and the tail comfortably inside the frame.
art_direction.palette: soft olive, muted violet, pale peach, sky blue
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
